headline: The hour arrives without a bell.
body: A bus takes the corner and leaves a wet line where it turned. The lamp over the desk stays on, though the room is no longer dark. We note the time and do not change the sentence.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: pale white, cloud unbroken at the edges

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp still on, room no longer dark

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: bus corner, wet line, then empty
